title: Web Console Documentation
description: Documentation for the web-console scenario — a browser-based terminal with PTY-backed sessions, pane layouts, AI command generation, and voice/TTS. Structure mirrors the reference-react-vite template; `guides/`, `concepts/GLOSSARY.md`, `reference/tts-api.md`, and several `internal/` files are template-extensions specific to this scenario.
